// diagnostic

E0121

`{name}` was consumed by {consumer}, so it can't be used here

What

`{name}` was consumed by {consumer}, so it can't be used here

Why

After a value moves somewhere else, its old name no longer gives access to it

Fix

Stop using `{name}` after the move, or give {consumer} a copy with `{name}.copy()` where it moved.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0121: tests/ui/E0121_lambda_move_outer_use.stderr.

Error [jet.UseAfterMove]: `name` was consumed by the move `^name`, so it can't be used here
  --> tests/ui/E0121_lambda_move_outer_use.jet:5:11
    |
  5 |     print(name)
    |           ^^^^
  --> tests/ui/E0121_lambda_move_outer_use.jet:3:18
    |
  3 |     f :: () -> { ^name }
    |                  ^^^^^ `name` moved to the move `^name` here
 Why: After a value moves somewhere else, its old name no longer gives access to it
 Fix: Stop using `name` after the move, or give the move `^name` a copy with `name.copy()` where it moved.
